learned_rules.situation: When a task explicitly requires N hops of retrieval but fewer than N hops (or zero hops) are performed
learned_rules.reason: B.9 (Coordinator_Premature_Hop_Termination) applies when the coordinator stops the retrieval chain before completing all required hops. The taxonomy explicitly states to 'Check who triggers conclusion: if Coordinator stops requesting hops = B.9'. When NO retrieval occurs despite explicit multi-hop requirements, the coordinator has stopped requesting hops (at hop 0), making this B.9.
learned_rules.not_code: Don't use B.3 (Solver_Premature_Verification_Conclusion) unless there is evidence that: (1) some retrieval was performed, (2) a Solver analyzed that evidence, and (3) the Solver then rendered a definitive verdict despite the evidence being insufficient. B.3 requires solver action on available evidence; B.9 is about coordinator failing to request/continue retrieval.
